title_zh: 免費網上培訓：跳過情緒——認識宗教與靈性創傷中的靈性迴避（11 月 18 日，1 CE）
title_en: Skipping past emotion spiritual bypassing religious spiritual trauma webinar
summary_zh: Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy 免費網上講座，由 Kennesha Rodgers（MA, LAPC, CTP）主講，主題是宗教與靈性創傷中的靈性迴避（spiritual bypassing）：以靈性語言或修習繞過情緒處理的現象。講座針對臨床工作者，講解如何辨識靈性迴避、它如何阻礙創傷處理，以及在治療中回應的方法。2026 年 11 月 18 日星期三美國東部時間 12:00–13:00 舉行，Zoom 線上，免費參加，可獲 1 小時繼續教育學分（NBCC、賓州社工、LPC、LMFT、心理學家；須全程出席）。
summary_en: The Phoenix Center for Experiential Trauma Therapy offers a free webinar, "Skipping Past Emotion: Understanding Spiritual Bypassing in Religious and Spiritual Trauma", facilitated by Kennesha Rodgers (MA, LAPC, CTP). It covers spiritual bypassing in religious and spiritual trauma - using spiritual language or practices to bypass emotional processing - including how to recognise it, how it blocks trauma processing, and how to respond in therapy. It runs on Wednesday 18 November 2026, 12:00-13:00 Eastern, on Zoom, free, with 1 CE hour (NBCC, PA social workers, LPC, LMFT, psychologists; full attendance required).

related.summary_zh: 2026 年 11 月 10 日美東時間上午 9 時至 12:15，Drexel 舉辦網上培訓，由 Karin Gladney 博士主講。課程以 Snyder 希望理論與 Pargament 宗教靈性因應理論為本，探討希望、靈性與意義建構在精神健康與復元中的保護作用，並教授如何以合乎倫理及文化敏感的方式融入評估與介入。收費 27 美元，3 學分。
related.summary_en: Drexel University College of Medicine's live webinar on November 10, 2026 (9:00 a.m.-12:15 p.m. ET; 10:00 p.m.-1:15 a.m. Macau time), led by Karin C. Gladney, PhD, explores hope and spirituality as foundations of psychological well-being, drawing on Snyder's hope theory and Pargament's religious/spiritual coping framework. Cost is $27 for 3 CE credits (APA, NBCC and others).
